notes: v228 — UMAR-CONNECT-VIABILITY (owner, Oct 23, 2026 06:57 MDT: "make sure a million times that umars connection is viable and he sees everything that is going on daily"): the exhaustive verification campaign for the v226 fix — ten scenarios driven through the real app.js/cloudsync/connectlive/connectpipe in driver + partner vm worlds over one fake Firestore (tools/umar-connect-viability-test.js, 120 checks). PROVEN SOUND: the full-access surface end to end (every closed day in history with its exact foreman+travel close, dispatches + manifests, fuel + receipts + the receipt photo itself, expenses, PTI with plate/result/defects, the driver's own wage, the billed invoice at exact totals — a closed day prices $930.00 revenue / $319.00 wages on the boss's books), the v226 rolled-back day republish, corrected closes replacing the first close, back-to-back days incl. a partner still on the previous build reading the new docs, fresh-pair full-history publish at pair formation, Maria's Limited scope exactly as ticked, and the revoke path (pruned from day/records/billing/photo docs, and never resurrected by a later rolled-back republish). THREE DEFECTS FOUND RED AND FIXED, js/connectpipe.js only: (1) CANCELLED DAY (S3) — a cancelled dispatch was filtered out of the shared day, so the partner's board kept showing the job open forever, and a day cancelled before its first publish never landed at all; cancelled dispatches now ride the record marked cancelled (no close, no loads — the day counters skip them), so the partner sees the day as no-work, never phantom hours. (2) RECORDS/BILLING/MANIFESTS DEGRADE (S8 — the gap parked by name in the v226 run) — publishRecords could be rewritten backward by a rolled-back store, and the clearing passes mistook an empty rolled-back build for a revocation and EMPTIED live docs (Umar's invoice doc, Maria's manifests doc; today's receipt photo was pruned with it). Publishes are now read-merge-write under the v226 preserve discipline (CP._preserveRecords / _preserveBilling / _preserveManifests: union by record identity, fresh values win per record, an invoice leaves only when the current books still hold its id and deliberately exclude it), the photo prune follows the PUBLISHED records doc, and the clearing passes fire only when a peer is gone or no longer entitled. ACCESS IS NEVER PRESERVED: viewers always come from the fresh doc, so a revoke prunes exactly as before. (3) publishRecords' wrote-report again means a write actually landed (the read-merge chains resolve with their guarded write's result). Regressions: viability 120/120, umar-connect-blank 64/64, connect-pipe 76/77 (the one failure is the parked stale key-set pin, identical on HEAD), connect-share-v146 96/96, connect-pick-v207 61/61, connect-live 85/85, connect-namespace-v219 27/27, cloudsync-merge 14/14, connect-kinds-v148 107/107, connect-modules-v176 40/40. Native unchanged (v40 carries the web-OTA pointer, so the fix reaches installed apps by the web update path). Machine-green is preparation — the final verdict is still Umar's own screen.
